Pay-per-token Foundation Model API decision endpoint (OpenJev, Qwen 3.5 4B) queried through the System One API. The serving-endpoints API lists it at 0.6 DBUs per 1M input tokens (input_price on the foundation_model entry, read 2026-10-27); input_cost_per_token is that dbu cost * $0.070, the same conversion as the other databricks rows. Output is free. Databricks publishes no cache rates for it, so cache tokens bill at the input rate.

TypeSafe AI Jev 1.14.0, provider-hosted by TypeSafe AI and served through Unity Gateway, queried through the System One API. The proprietary pricing page lists 'Jev 1.14' at 0.600 DBU per 1M input tokens; input_cost_per_token is that times $0.070 per DBU. Output is free. No cache rates are published, so cache tokens bill at the input rate.
The ai_decide AI Function (Beta), called through POST /api/2.0/ai-functions/ai-decide. Its response carries no token usage, so LiteLLM records no spend for it.
